monsterFluff.name: Blood-Queen Lana'thel
entries: Less than a decade ago, Lana'thel marched under Kael'thas Sunstrider in an attempt to defeat the Lich King and claim revenge against the Scourge for the losses she suffered in the Third War. But Arthas defeated the blood elf forces, and the survivors scattered across the frozen wastes of Northrend. Arthas hunted each one down, and he personally raised Lana'thel to undeath to be the queen of the San'layn.

monsterFluff.name: Darkfallen Blood Prince
entries: The three princes of the darkfallen—Keleseth, Taldaram, and Valanar—are lieutenants of the {@creature Lich King Arthas|WoW|Lich King} who rule fiefdoms in Northrend in Arthas's name. Prince Keleseth ruled the southeastern part of the continent as Scourge overlord of the Howling Fjord and served as liaison to the vrykul in Utgarde Keep. The Lich King sent Prince Taldaram to the nerubian city of Ahn'kahet to collect ancient relics to empower the Scourge. Prince Valanar, Keleseth's brother, ruled over the Borean Tundra from the necropolis of Naxxanar and manipulated the Alliance leadership in Valiance Keep by disguising himself as a human adviser named Counselor Talbot.

monsterFluff.name: Deathbringer Saurfang

entries: With every Horde and Alliance soldier that has fallen in this pointless squabble of yours, the Lich King's armies have grown. Even now the val'kyr work to raise your fallen as Scourge. Things are about to get much worse. Taste the power the Lich King has bestowed on me!
Join me, father. Join me and we will crush this world in the name of the Scourge—for the glory of the Lich King!

A young orc warrior named Dranosh Saurfang commanded the Horde's Warsong Offensive in Northrend and led the Horde forces at the Battle of the Wrathgate. Born a Mag'har orc on Draenor, uncorrupted by demonic blood, Dranosh held firm to the ideals of honor and wisdom. He fell to the {@creature Lich King Arthas|WoW|Lich King} at the Wrathgate, and Arthas raised him as a death knight.

monsterFluff.name: Deathspeaker High Priest
entries: Lady Deathwhisper's high priests are Undead {@book nerubians|WoW|7|Nerubians} empowered with divine magic by their devotion to the Cult of the Damned. Towering about 18 feet tall on their four spiderlike legs, they wear priestly vestments and elaborate headdresses that make them seem even taller.

monsterFluff.name: Festergut
entries: Festergut is one of two {@creature Abomination|WoW|abominations} created by {@creature Professor Putricide, Phase 1|ICC|Professor Putricide}. Festergut has a childlike mind, calls Putricide "Daddy," and seems to cherish its pet {@creature plague-dog|ICC}, Stinky, but it shares Putricide's loathing of all living things.

monsterFluff.name: Frost Wyrm
entries: Frost wyrms are Undead dragons created from the skeletal remains of adult dragons of the {@book blue dragonflight|WoW|7|Blue Dragonflight}. The first Lich King, Ner'zhul, animated the remains of long-dead dragons who fell during the War of the Ancients, and {@creature Lich King Arthas|WoW|Arthas} continued that practice when he raised Sindragosa to become the frost queen.

monsterFluff.name: Lady Deathwhisper

entries: You can see through the fog that hangs over this world like a shroud, and grasp where true power lies. Fix your eyes upon your crude hands: the sinew, the soft meat, the dark blood coursing within. It is a weakness, a crippling flaw—a joke played by the Creators upon their own creations. The sooner you come to accept your condition as a defect, the sooner you will find yourselves in a position to transcend it. Through our Master, all things are possible. His power is without limit, and his will unbending. Those who oppose him will be destroyed utterly, and those who serve—who serve wholly, unquestioningly, with utter devotion of mind and soul—will be elevated to heights beyond your ken.

Lady Deathwhisper is the Supreme Overseer of the Cult of the Damned, the {@creature Lich King Arthas|WoW|Lich King's} cult of death worshippers. Her oratorical skills and electric personality make her an ideal evangelist for the cult's twisted message—that undeath is the only path to true power, free from the weakness of mortal flesh.

monsterFluff.name: Lord Marrowgar
entries: Lord Marrowgar is the guardian of the Frozen Throne within the Spire Chamber. Pieced together by the {@creature Lich King Arthas|WoW|Lich King} from the bones of a thousand vanquished adventurers, Marrowgar wields the power of the throne itself.

monsterFluff.name: Plague-Dog
entries: Plague-dogs, also called zombie dogs, are a form of Scourge abomination pieced together from animal parts rather than pieces of humanoid flesh. The first of their kind, a horror called Gluth, was created to serve as a guardian in the necropolis of Naxxramas. {@creature Professor Putricide, Phase 1|ICC|Professor Putricide} created two more—Precious and Stinky—apparently to serve as pets to his abomination "children," {@creature Festergut|ICC} and {@creature Rotface|ICC}.

monsterFluff.name: Plagueworks Ooze
entries: {@creature Professor Putricide, Phase 1|ICC|Professor Putricide's} ooze lab is a workshop for the creation of ooze monsters. Putricide's abomination {@creature Rotface|ICC} infects opponents with a mutating disorder that results in the victim expelling a Plagueworks ooze; the oozes seek each other out and merge to form larger and larger oozes. The creation of an ooze large enough to engulf the whole world is one path toward eliminating life on Azeroth that Professor Putricide has envisioned.

monsterFluff.name: Professor Putricide, Phase 1
entries: Professor Putricide is one of the evil geniuses responsible for creating innovative ways to spread the Scourge, destroy the living, and create new undead soldiers for the {@creature Lich King Arthas|WoW|Lich King's} armies. His alchemical research focuses on toxic gases and mutagenic slimes.

monsterFluff.name: Pustulating Horror
entries: The pustulating horrors found in Icecrown Citadel are one variety of plague eruptors—oversize zombies designed to spread horror, chaos, and the undead plague as part of Scourge armies. The bloated sores across a pustulating horror's body erupt with toxic plague whenever the horror is hit in combat, and it explodes in a fiery inferno when it is killed.

monsterFluff.name: Rotface
entries: Rotface is one of two {@creature Abomination|WoW|abominations} created by {@creature Professor Putricide, Phase 1|ICC|Professor Putricide}. Rotface has a childlike mind and voice and calls Putricide "Daddy." It is devoted to its pet {@creature plague-dog|ICC}, Precious, and erupts in fury if any harm comes to the creature. It also despises the living and seeks to spread Putricide's mutated slimes to wipe them out.

monsterFluff.name: Servant of the Throne
entries: Servants of the Throne are a form of lesser lich, skeletal mages bound to the Frozen Throne and the {@creature Lich King Arthas|WoW|Lich King} who sits upon it. They wield frost magic empowered by the throne.

monsterFluff.name: Sindragosa
entries: During the War of the Ancients, the {@book blue dragonflight|WoW|7|Blue Dragonflight} was decimated; many of the dragons, including Malygos's consort Sindragosa, fell onto ground that later became covered by the Icecrown Glacier. After Ner'zhul raised many of the dead blue dragons up as frost wyrms in service of the Scourge, Arthas continued the practice, raising Sindragosa and even the dead dragon whelps.

Sindragosa's first death was caused by Deathwing's betrayal. Perhaps that made it easier for the {@creature Lich King Arthas|WoW|Lich King} to turn her and twist her in undeath; his final desecration was to tear apart the spirits of her whelps in front of her. Now she defends the Lich King in Icecrown Citadel and serves as his mount.

monsterFluff.name: Sister Svalna
entries: Sister Svalna is the foremost among the ranks of the Scourge's val'kyr—undead angelic beings formed from the ranks of fallen vrykul warriors. She helped {@creature Lich King Arthas|WoW|Arthas} create the death knights of Acherus and supervised their training, alongside other val'kyr, ensuring that they didn't perish before their training was complete.

monsterFluff.name: The Damned
entries: The Damned are skeletal horrors with scythe-like claws in place of hands. They are assembled from the bones of other living creatures, and they have jagged blades protruding from their bodies, as well as sharp tusks. As their name suggests, they are animated by trapped souls that are tormented by their imprisonment.

monsterFluff.name: Tirion Fordring

entries: This is our final stand. What happens here will echo through the ages. Regardless of the outcome, they will know that we fought with honor—that we fought for the freedom and safety of our people! Remember, heroes, fear is your greatest enemy in these befouled halls. Steel your hearts, and your souls will shine brighter than a thousand suns. The enemy will falter at the sight of you. They will fall as the light of righteousness envelops them! Our march upon Icecrown Citadel begins now!

Tirion Fordring was one of the first five paladins of the Order of the Silver Hand—a martial extension of the Church of Light. Archbishop Alonsus Faol chose Tirion, as well as four other human heroes, to serve as a champion of the church during the Second War. Excommunicated for showing mercy to an orc, Tirion rejoined the paladins after the Third War to fight the Scourge, and he has been battling the forces of the {@creature Lich King Arthas|WoW|Lich King} ever since. He wields the sword {@item Ashbringer|WoW}, which he helped to purify after it was corrupted by its original wielder's act of murder. After repelling the Lich King's forces from Light's Hope Chapel, Tirion united the Argent Dawn and the Knights of the Silver Hand to form the Argent Crusade, and he personally led the assault on Northrend.

monsterFluff.name: Val'kyr Herald
entries: The first val'kyr were angelic beings created by Odyn, one of the keepers of the titan Aman-Thul. Odyn objected to the creation of the Dragon Aspects and created the val'kyr as alternative protectors of Azeroth. The {@creature Lich King Arthas|WoW|Lich King} created his own version of these warriors from the vrykul of Northrend and employed them to train and sustain his death knights and other warriors. Val'kyr heralds patrol inside and outside Icecrown Citadel, ensuring that no one approaches the Frozen Throne by air.

monsterFluff.name: Vengeful Geist
entries: Geists are hideous creatures of the Scourge. The first were created from the corpses of executed criminals, and all geists still wear the hood and noose of a hanging victim. A geist's hooded face is dominated by a single yellow eye, and its voice is a harsh rasp. Geists move with surprising quickness, using all four limbs in an unnerving, loping gait.
